factual_methodology.summary: The pandemic-emergency classification is attributed to the WHO committee's current formal record, although the cited WHO page attributes that classification to the Director-General's original 17 May determination. limitations: WHO cumulative counts are as of 17 November; the 20 November publication date is not a synchronized epidemiological snapshot.
Africa CDC's 11% case-identification-from-contact-lists measure and WHO's 81% daily contact-follow-up measure use different denominators and periods.
Security incidents and casualties are attributed to WHO and partner statements and are not independently verified in this review.
The regional map uses country-status cards rather than geographic coordinates and explicitly preserves the different observation dates.
The repository-wide editorial-depth workflow also fails on six pre-existing staged documents; this candidate is independently listed as one of the failures.

Preserve observation dates, units, source attribution and identical numeric series across EN/PT-BR. Do not create a decorative chart or fabricate observations. Re-run scripts/validate-editorial-depth.mjs and confirm this candidate no longer appears in the failures.

issues.evidence: The text says that 'the WHO committee's formal record' states the event did not meet IHR criteria for a pandemic emergency. The cited WHO IHR Emergency Committee page attributes that classification to the Director-General's determination of 17 May 2026; it states that the event was a PHEIC but did not meet the pandemic-emergency criteria. The 20 November WHO Disease Outbreak News says the Director-General, on 18 November and following the third committee meeting on 17 November, maintained the PHEIC status; it does not report a new pandemic-emergency determination by that third meeting. The current prose therefore blurs the original 17 May determination with the 18 November reaffirmation and misattributes the decision to the committee's formal record. Sources: https://www.who.int/groups/ihr-emergency-committee-regarding-the-epidemic-of-ebola-bundibugyo-virus-disease-in-the-drc-and-uganda and https://www.who.int/emergencies/disease-outbreak-news/item/2026-DON630
issues.required_correction: Date and attribute the pandemic-emergency classification explicitly to the WHO Director-General's 17 May 2026 determination. State separately that the 18 November 2026 decision, following the 17 November third IHR Emergency Committee meeting, reaffirmed the PHEIC. Do not imply that the third meeting issued a new pandemic-emergency determination. Use the direct 17 May WHO statement as a claim-specific reference and retain the 20 November Disease Outbreak News for the PHEIC reaffirmation.
